definition.title: CPU Throttled (Avg)
definition.description: Significant and consistent CPU throttling on cluster check runners indicates telemetry collection may be stalling/delayed. Consider increasing CPU requests and replica count

definition.title: Last Terminated Reason
definition.description: **Warning**: this is a monotonic count based on pod `.status.containerStatuses[*].lastState.terminated.reason`

queries.name: query1
queries.query: sum:kubernetes.containers.last_state.terminated{(kube_app_component:clusterchecks-agent OR kube_app_component:cluster-checks-runner) AND $namespace AND $cluster AND reason:error} by {kube_container_name,reason}

queries.name: query2
queries.query: sum:kubernetes.containers.last_state.terminated{(kube_app_component:clusterchecks-agent OR kube_app_component:cluster-checks-runner) AND $namespace AND $cluster AND reason:oomkilled} by {kube_container_name,reason}

definition.title: Busyness (by Runner)
definition.description: Busyness is computed by the leader Cluster Agent only during cluster-check rebalancing, which runs every `cluster_checks.rebalance_period` (default 10m). New CLC runners and newly elected leaders have no data until the next rebalance, so gaps of up to about 10 minutes after runner restarts, rollouts, or leader changes are expected and don't mean checks stopped running
